name: 49457 · Twin Lake, MI
findings: ZIP 49457 (Twin Lake) has 23 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49457 (Twin Lake) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
